name: PastePal
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For PastePal, keep a local clipboard history with collections, search, and sensitive-item rules. The hard boundary is native apple apps, icloud sync, rich content support, and polish, plus os integration polish and maintenance.
